body:
Status: Done

Summary:
- phantom-node/README.md extended with start scenarios and examples:
  - QUIC listener: P2pQuicListen (store_dir, fsync, k, optional genesis, tx_proposer, pow_miner, mint params)
  - QUIC client: P2pQuicConnect
  - libp2p service: P2pRun
  - Metrics endpoint: P2pMetricsServe (Prometheus)
  - Status endpoint: StatusServe (Auth via Bearer token optional, TLS/mTLS options)
  - BuildPayload (offline)
  - Consensus tools: ConsensusAckDists, ConsensusPayoutRoot
- pc-p2p/README.md added with bench guide:
  - Bench-Mode: set_bench_mode(true) to disable anti-entropy during measurements
  - One-shot watchers: watch_header(), watch_payload() wired via dispatch_watchers()
  - How to run benches (features "async" and "async libp2p"); raw data under target/criterion_raw/; aggregator bin (bench_agg) writes target/criterion_agg.{json,csv}

References:
- crates/phantom-node/README.md
- crates/phantom-node/src/main.rs (CLI: NodeOpts/Command and Args structs)
- crates/pc-p2p/README.md
- crates/pc-p2p/benches/* and src/bin/bench_agg.rs

No further action required.
